responsibility: This tutorial example shows how the C API represents local variables and explicit control-flow graphs in libgccjit. It constructs an exported loop_test function with locals, multiple named basic blocks, conditional branching, assignment operations, and a final return to compute a sum of squares loop, then compiles and executes the result. Its main responsibility is illustrating block-level CFG construction rather than single-expression functions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/docs/examples/tut03-sum-of-squares.cc, this same-stem control-flow tutorial builds the loop with the C API’s explicit gcc_jit_* constructors for blocks, comparisons, assignments, and jumps.
